newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-OVER 1,000 NEW CARS SOLD IN JULY-REPORT.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-OVER 1,000 NEW CARS SOLD IN JULY-REPORT.

text.p: New car sales were up to over 1000 cars in July, setting a new record, newspaper Aripaev said on Friday.
Data from various dealerships show that 1,164 new cars were sold in July with the previous high set in May this year when 977 new cars were sold, the newspaper said.
The Honda make was the most popular with over 200 new cars sold.
The popularity of leasing to finance new car purchases was the main reason for the increase, with 80 percent of new cars sold under finance to leasing companies, the newspaper added.
